## What and why

## Constitution check

- [ ] I. Raw transcripts stay on the device; sync stays opt-in per source; no new telemetry
- [ ] II. Scope is enforced in the data layer; answers cite or escalate
- [ ] III. Nothing sends messages on the owner's behalf; clipboard is restored
- [ ] IV. No pipeline logic duplicated outside the TypeScript server
- [ ] V. Safety-critical changes have tests written first; `pnpm evals` passes
- [ ] VI. No new service or dependency without a justification
